sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND legacy IS FALSE) AS twin_trades, (SELECT count(*) FROM live_paper_parity_events WHERE twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND twin_outcome='opened') AS parity_opened, (SELECT count(*) FROM paper_trades t WHERE t.strategy='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND t.legacy IS FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM live_paper_parity_events e WHERE e.twin_tag='Fmmsell10_pt4' AND e.market_ticker=t.market_ticker)) AS trades_with_no_parity_row
